title: THE PARADOX OF POETIC INTENT IN BACK-TRANSLATION: EVALUATING THE QUALITY OF LARGE LANGUAGE MODELS IN CHINESE TRANSLATION
reasoning: The study evaluates LLM performance on texts containing significant spiritual and religious content, including Buddhist mantras and Taoist geomantic scriptures. It specifically benchmarks the models' ability to handle cultural nuance, religious symbolism, and hermeneutic challenges within the framework of poetic and literary translation.
